items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Enforce main pushes at a non-bypassable boundary**

This guard is installed solely as a local `pre-push` hook, so an orchestrator can bypass every refusal and its audit log with `git push --no-verify origin main`; `git push -h` explicitly documents `--no-verify` as “bypass pre-push hook,” and that command updates the remote without invoking this script. This reintroduces the direct-push path the change is meant to prevent, including force/deletion cases, so enforce the rule through GitHub branch protection or another server-side receive boundary rather than treating the client hook as the guard.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
items.disposition: not-applicable:a client-side pre-push hook cannot be made non-bypassable (--no-verify); the task forbade GitHub branch-protection changes, which are the operator-side server boundary recommended in the report and acceptance record

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve hooks that merely contain the marker**

If an existing `pre-push` hook contains this marker but is not byte-identical to the generated body—for example, a user adds an unrelated check to a previously generated hook—the marker-only test treats it as managed. The later equality check then falls through to the `mv`, silently replacing that hook and discarding its checks despite the documented foreign-hook preservation behavior. Require an exact managed body (or a dedicated managed section) before rewriting it.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Document the added pane-less SessionStart directive**

For a regime session outside Herdr, this new call emits a second stdout line after the advertised summary, but the CLI usage, README, and the agmsg skill still say `herdr-agents --attach` prints one line in that case. This leaves the documented hook contract false and does not describe the newly injected delegation and main-push instructions to users of that startup path.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/2360aea83973a3e989c54b126fd34ab7cbef52e8/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Restore execute permission on the managed hook**

After the generated hook is copied or restored with mode 0644 (or its execute bit is removed), its text still matches `body`, so this returns before the installation path's `chmod 755`. Git ignores a non-executable `pre-push` hook (reporting that it “was ignored because it's not set as executable”), and later `--bootstrap-agmsg` calls leave it disabled, allowing main pushes with no guard. Require `-x` here or re-chmod the exact managed stub.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/c63645240780fa71cbac165feeae6b4f3348e54d/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid installing a hook that invokes an older launcher**

`make upgrade` calls `agmsg-bootstrap` from the checked-out source (Makefile:124-138) without running `chezmoi apply`. Thus, on the first upgrade after this change, a canonical clone can install this stub while `command -v herdr-agents` still resolves to the prior managed helper, which does not recognize `--main-push-guard`; every subsequent push, including a feature branch carrying the upgrade's pin diff, exits after the old helper prints usage. Run a guard guaranteed to be deployed at the same version, or defer installing the stub until the helper has been applied.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/c63645240780fa71cbac165feeae6b4f3348e54d/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.body:
The following taps are not trusted:
  aws/tap
  azure/bicep
  hashicorp/tap

Homebrew is currently ignoring formulae, casks and commands from these taps because tap trust is required.

Prefer trusting only the specific formulae, casks or commands you need.
Trust installed formulae from these taps with:
  brew trust --formula azure/bicep/bicep
  brew trust --formula hashicorp/tap/packer
Trust other specific casks and commands with:
  brew trust --cask <user>/<tap>/<cask>
  brew trust --command <user>/<tap>/<command>
Whole-tap trust is broader and includes all current and future formulae,
casks and commands from the listed taps. Trust whole taps with:
  brew trust aws/tap azure/bicep hashicorp/tap
Untap them with:
  brew untap aws/tap azure/bicep hashicorp/tap
To disable trust checks:
  export HOMEBREW_NO_REQUIRE_TAP_TRUST=1
This is not recommended and will be removed in a later release.
For more information, see:
  https://docs.brew.sh/Tap-Trust
